summary: A further revised set of ARPANET mailing lists for distributing network documents. List A is the Network Liaison Group, who receive RFCs and other formal documents first, and lists B and C are for other participants and station agents.

plainLanguage.summary: This RFC provides three mailing lists for distributing Network documents. Each list serves a different group of liaisons, participants or station agents.

subtitle: Three mailing lists used by the Network Information Center to distribute documents.

tldr.problem: Network documents needed to reach liaisons, non-site participants and station agents through the appropriate mailing lists.
tldr.mechanism: The RFC provides three lists with contacts and postal information: Network Liaison Group, NIC distribution and NIC Station Agents.
tldr.outcome: RFC 402 obsoletes RFC 363 and records the distribution arrangements of October 1972.

today: RFC 402 obsoletes RFC 363. The contact information documents the Network Information Center's arrangements in October 1972.

sections.title: Three Document Distribution Lists
sections.content:
The Network Information Center published three lists for distribution of Network documents. The document gives contact details for the people assigned to site or participant roles and obsoletes RFC 363.

The lists reflect the Network Information Center's distribution arrangements at the time of publication.
sections.plainLanguage: The RFC organizes document recipients into three lists. It gives contact details for the listed people.

sections.title: List A: Network Liaisons
sections.content:
List A includes Network Liaisons and others who should receive the initial distribution of RFCs, whether sent by the NIC or by sites. They also receive selected catalogs and other formal NIC documents.

Sites are instructed to use this list when distributing their own documents so RFCs reach liaisons quickly. All mail except local mail should be sent Air Mail.
sections.plainLanguage: List A is for initial distribution of RFCs and selected formal documents. Sites are asked to use it when sending their own documents.

sections.title: Lists B and C
sections.content:
List B contains non-site Network participants who receive formal Network documents from the NIC. They receive documents with the liaison mailing when one is made, or when documents are sent to Station Agents.

List C contains NIC Station Agents. They receive copies of documents distributed to liaisons and documents in the Station collection. The RFC says mailings occur weekly or more often when the quantity warrants.
sections.plainLanguage: List B is for non-site participants, while List C is for NIC Station Agents. The Station Agent mailing is weekly or more frequent when needed.
